name: refuse-never
description: A refusal no caller action can lift. It still projects to a normal isError tool result — a terminal refusal is a wire state, never a thrown error. Carried on `billing_mode_anomaly` since registry v9 retired `tier_unrecognized`; the graded property is the `never` retry class, not the particular code.
